text.arabic_uthmani: ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا۟ تَفَثَهُمْ وَلْيُوفُوا۟ نُذُورَهُمْ وَلْيَطَّوَّفُوا۟ بِٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْعَتِيقِ

words.gloss_range: delayed sequential connector that opens a later ritual-completion stage rather than a flat continuation
words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) opens a staged afterward, not a simple additive link. It carries the prior rites into a later completion sequence and lets the following three jussive commands remain under that ordered frame. Its doubled consonant gives the opening a heavier beat, and its rounded sound anticipates the repeated command cadence. The particle therefore makes the ayah move from earlier sacrificial acts into a body, vow, and House triad, with the opening sequence eventually landing at the enduring House qualifier.

topics.headline: delayed ritual stage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the commands are staged after the preceding rites rather than merely appended to them.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a sequential conjunction, and the local clauses form a command sequence after the previous ayah's rites.

topics.headline: scope over the command triad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees all three commands as one procedural unit rather than isolating the first verb from the later coordinated commands.
topics.reason: The following two clauses are coordinated with the first jussive clause, so the opening sequence marker frames the whole triad.

topics.headline: ordered arrival at the House
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's movement from a temporal hinge to a closing sacred locus, so sequence becomes arrival.
topics.reason: The word opens the ayah while the final noun phrase supplies the endpoint of the commanded movement.

topics.headline: heavy opening cadence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the opening connector as a weighty pivot into the repeated command cadence.
topics.reason: The particle's doubled consonant and later rounded command endings support the recited sense of a linked procedural chain.

words.gloss_range: first command lām governing a third-person jussive, with variant vocalization affecting cadence but not command force
words.prose: {{ar:لْ}} ({{tr:l-}}) supplies the first explicit command particle. It turns the following imperfect into a third-person injunction and keeps the clause from being read as purpose or narrative. Because the same particle returns before the second and third verbs, this first clipped onset establishes the repeated legal cadence; the vocalized variant softens the entry but leaves the obligation intact.

topics.headline: first jussive command particle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the first verb as a commanded act, not as a purpose clause or report.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the particle as lām al-amr governing the following jussive verb.

topics.headline: start of repeated command frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first particle establish the pattern that makes the three actions parallel obligations.
topics.reason: The same command particle recurs at words 6 and 10 before coordinated jussive verbs.

topics.headline: variant vocalization without changed force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a recitational pressure point at the command onset while retaining the same imperative value.
topics.reason: The vocalized variant changes the sound of the onset, but local grammar still keeps the particle in command function.

topics.headline: bound to the verb complex
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees command force fused directly to the verb rather than detached as a free-standing idea.
topics.reason: The particle is a proclitic command marker attached to the following imperfect verb.

words.gloss_range: commanded completion or settlement of a specified ritual bodily state, narrowed away from objectless decree or judgment
words.root_gloss_range: range includes deciding, judging, decreeing, finishing, settling, expiring, and requiring; the local object selects completion/resolution while juridical finality remains a secondary pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the first command's possessed bodily-ritual object

words.prose: {{ar:يَقْضُوا۟}} ({{tr:yaqḍū}}) is the first finite command after the prior sacrificial stage, so it turns earlier closure into the next required act. Its lām-governed jussive form projects completion forward as an obligation, and its plural ending keeps the pilgrims as collective agents even without an overt subject. The explicit object {{ar:تَفَثَهُمْ}} ({{tr:tafathahum}}) narrows {{ar:ق ض ي}} ({{tr:q-ḍ-y}}) away from an objectless decree sense toward resolving a concrete ritual state. Still, the root's judging, settling, and requirement field makes that bodily completion feel formally closed, not casual cleanup. Its indirect command form keeps a formal legal distance from direct address, and the hard qāf/ḍād onset carries decisive sound into the rough object.

topics.headline: commanded collective action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears completion as an obligation assigned to the pilgrim group, not a report about them.
topics.reason: The verb is an apocopated third-person masculine plural imperfect governed by the command lām.

topics.headline: completion narrowed by object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb resolves a named bodily-ritual state rather than issuing an abstract decree.
topics.reason: The explicit direct object selects the transitive completion branch while leaving juridical finality as coloring rather than the local gloss.

topics.headline: settled obligation pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the act as a definitive settlement demanded by the rite, not merely grooming after travel.
topics.reason: The wider root family supports finality and requirement, but the local object prevents those branches from replacing the completion sense.

topics.headline: first beat of body-vow-House movement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the first command begin the sequence at bodily resolution before the ayah moves to vows and the House.
topics.reason: The verb opens the three-command sequence and has a locally marked pairing with the unique object.

topics.headline: formal register and hard onset
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the legal distance of the indirect command and the decisive sound that leads into the rough object.
topics.reason: The lām-plus-imperfect complex differs from a direct imperative and carries a compact jussive command form.

topics.headline: closure after sacrifice
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this command to the previous rite's closure and sees the next required completion begin.
topics.reason: The preceding boundary and the rare local collocation make the first command a transition from one completed ritual stage into another.

words.gloss_range: possessed bodily-ritual residue or dishevelment, metonymically naming the state and the acts that end it
words.root_gloss_range: rare field covering dirt, hair and nail growth, grooming, washing, and exit from ritual restriction; the local collocation selects resolution of the pilgrims' possessed state
words.prose: {{ar:تَفَثَهُمْ}} ({{tr:tafathahum}}) is the object that the first command resolves. The word is corpus-unique, so its bodily range matters: dirt, hair, nails, grooming, and the ritual status that such acts end are compressed into one possessed state. The suffix makes that state theirs, carrying the same pilgrims across the boundary from the previous rites. Its rough sound and its pairing with the later vow object make the first panel bodily and personal before the ayah turns to covenant and place.

topics.headline: affected bodily state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the noun as the state acted upon by the first command, not as a loose ritual topic.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the noun as the explicit direct object of the preceding verb.

topics.headline: their own accumulated state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the bodily-ritual condition belongs to the pilgrims themselves and is not an abstract category.
topics.reason: The plural possessive suffix is attached directly to the noun and carries the participant group forward.

topics.headline: residue named as resolution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the command as ending a concrete residue-laden ritual state, while the noun can name both the problem and its prescribed removal.
topics.reason: The lexical evidence supports both bodily residue and the acts that terminate it, but the governing completion verb selects resolution rather than preserving impurity as an endpoint.

topics.headline: unique concrete ritual term
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this single Quranic occurrence must carry a dense bodily and ritual field locally.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks the root-form as a single occurrence, and the lexical evidence supplies the concrete body-related range.

topics.headline: rough first object panel
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the first object as the bodily panel paired with vows before the sequence reaches the House.
topics.reason: The word occupies the first object slot and shares suffix patterning with the later vow object.

topics.headline: same pilgrims across the boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the prior social rite to the pilgrims' own bodily condition instead of treating this ayah as detached.
topics.reason: The suffix and boundary rows keep the same participant group active after the ayah shifts register.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that opens a distinct second jussive command while preserving sequence continuity
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) links the completed first command to the second without merging them. It blocks the vow object from becoming an explanation of the bodily object and instead pivots the ayah from personal ritual state to pledged obligation. Because it is bound into the following command lām, the connector keeps the chain continuous while giving the second beat its own command entry.

topics.headline: second command coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees vow fulfillment as a separate coordinated duty, not an apposition to bodily resolution.
topics.reason: The conjunction links a new jussive command clause after the first verb-object unit is complete.

topics.headline: pivot from body to vows
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's shift from bodily state to covenantal obligation at this connector.
topics.reason: The connector follows the first object and precedes the second command complex.

topics.headline: later-command entry pulse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second and third commands enter through matching connector-plus-command-particle openings.
topics.reason: The conjunction is followed immediately by the command lām, matching the later connector before the final command.

words.gloss_range: second command lām renewing jussive force after coordination and maintaining the legal command register
words.prose: {{ar:لْ}} ({{tr:l-}}) renews command force for the middle verb instead of letting the first command particle govern by implication. The repetition gives vow fulfillment the same legal weight as bodily resolution. Its attachment inside the {{tr:wa-l-}} command complex also keeps the middle beat visibly parallel with the final command, while the vocalized variant affects onset smoothness rather than obligation.

topics.headline: renewed middle command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second action receive its own explicit obligation rather than borrowing command force from the first clause.
topics.reason: The second lām al-amr governs the following jussive verb after a coordinating conjunction.

topics.headline: visible middle command complex
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the middle command as a parallel pulse in the threefold legal sequence.
topics.reason: The connector, command particle, and verb form one command complex that matches the later final command complex.

topics.headline: recited onset pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the variant vocalization belongs to the command onset while the local command function remains stable.
topics.reason: The variant affects the lām's vocalization, but attachment evidence still identifies the particle as command-governing.

words.gloss_range: commanded full discharge of vows, with Form IV and explicit object selecting fulfillment over general completeness or unrelated root branches
words.root_gloss_range: range includes fulfilling, paying in full, completing, exacting full measure, sufficiency, and full taking; local Form IV plus vow object selects full discharge of obligations

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the middle command's possessed plural vow object

words.prose: {{ar:يُوفُوا۟}} ({{tr:yūfū}}) is the middle command, and its explicit object {{ar:نُذُورَهُمْ}} ({{tr:nudhūrahum}}) makes fulfillment concrete. The Form IV verb presents the pilgrims as actively bringing their vows to full measure, while the jussive plural form keeps the same commanded group in view. The wider {{ar:و ف ي}} ({{tr:w-f-y}}) field of full payment, exact measure, and completion makes the vows feel like obligations with no remainder left unpaid; variant forms sharpen that payment-in-full pressure without changing the local vow-discharge frame. Positioned between body-resolution and House-circling, the verb mediates the sequence, and its long ū-vowel beat makes the fullness of the vow panel audible.

topics.headline: fulfilling specific vows
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees fulfillment aimed at specific vows, not a vague call to be faithful.
topics.reason: The verb has an explicit vow object, selecting transitive discharge in the local frame.

topics.headline: commanded active completion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pilgrims are commanded to bring the vows to completion as collective agents.
topics.reason: The local form is a lām-governed third-person masculine plural Form IV imperfect.

topics.headline: no-remainder fulfillment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels vow fulfillment as payment to full measure rather than partial observance.
topics.reason: The wider root field supports full-measure completion, while the vow object keeps that pressure inside the local fulfillment sense.

topics.headline: variant intensification and indirect command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the command register and variant pressure without replacing the canonical Form IV vow fulfillment.
topics.reason: Variant evidence can sharpen payment nuance, but canonical local morphology remains a Form IV third-person jussive.

topics.headline: bridge between body and House
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees vow fulfillment as the middle panel between bodily resolution and spatial circumambulation.
topics.reason: The verb occupies the middle position in the coordinated jussive sequence and is paired locally with the vow root.

topics.headline: rounded vow-beat sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the vow beat as full and extended while recognizing its link to broader covenant-fulfillment language.
topics.reason: The long vowel pattern and wider Form IV covenant parallels reinforce the local full-discharge sense.

words.gloss_range: their multiple vows as direct object of fulfillment, with warning-root consequence pressure narrowed by the governing verb
words.root_gloss_range: range includes vow, warning, warner, threat, and consequential announcement; local noun form and fulfillment verb select vows while retaining self-binding seriousness

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the governing fulfillment verb that selects the vow sense
the earlier possessed bodily-ritual object paired with the vow object

words.prose: {{ar:نُذُورَهُمْ}} ({{tr:nudhūrahum}}) gives the middle command its object: their vows, plural and possessed. The broken plural distributes pledge-burden across the pilgrims, while the suffix keeps the same group in view and makes the vows definite by attachment. The root's warning-heavy field is narrowed by {{ar:يُوفُوا۟}} ({{tr:yūfū}}) to the vow noun, yet that background gives the vows a consequence-shaped seriousness; the same-surah warning register at 22:49 shadows that seriousness without replacing the local vow sense. Structurally, the word mirrors {{ar:تَفَثَهُمْ}} ({{tr:tafathahum}}): body-state and pledge-obligation are paired as personal burdens before the final movement to the House.

topics.headline: vows as discharge object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the vows as the concrete commitments receiving the action of fulfillment.
topics.reason: The noun is accusative as the direct object of the fulfillment verb.

topics.headline: multiple owned commitments
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command concerns their own multiple vows, not vow-making in general.
topics.reason: The broken plural noun carries a third-person plural possessive suffix.

topics.headline: warning-colored vows
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the vows as self-binding obligations with consequences, while the local syntax keeps vow as the selected sense.
topics.reason: The root family supports warning senses, but the governing fulfillment verb and noun pattern select vows locally.

topics.headline: vow noun in warning-heavy root
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a marked specialization of a root more often associated with warning into the pilgrims' pledged obligations.
topics.reason: The local abstract noun form differs from active warning-agent forms and appears in a fulfillment frame.

topics.headline: paired with bodily object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees bodily residue and vows as matched personal burdens in the first two command beats.
topics.reason: This noun and the first object share object position and the same plural possessive suffix.

topics.headline: referent continuity and warning echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects solemn speech, vow discharge, and the same pilgrim group across the passage boundary.
topics.reason: The suffix preserves the participant chain, and the same-root warning field is attested elsewhere in the same surah at 22:49.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that opens the third command while separating circumambulation from vow fulfillment
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the final command as a third coordinated act. It prevents circumambulation from being swallowed into vow fulfillment and marks the last transition: from pledged obligations into movement around the sacred place. The repeated connector matches the earlier {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}), so the second and third commands enter as paired later beats inside the same sequence.

topics.headline: third coordinated act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees circumambulation as its own final command, not as a manner of fulfilling vows.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the final jussive clause after the second command's object is complete.

topics.headline: pivot into sacred place
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah shift from vows to spatial ritual at this connector.
topics.reason: The connector follows the vow object and introduces the circumambulation clause.

topics.headline: second wa-pulse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the middle and final commands enter with matching connector pulses.
topics.reason: The conjunction fuses to the final command lām just as the earlier conjunction fuses to the middle command lām.

words.gloss_range: third command lām explicitly governing the final jussive and completing the repeated command-particle architecture
words.prose: {{ar:لْ}} ({{tr:l-}}) gives the final verb its own explicit command scope. The ayah does not leave circumambulation to ellipsis from the earlier particles; it repeats the same legal marker one last time. That third repetition completes the command architecture, and the clipped particle releases into the heavier assimilated verb that closes the triad.

topics.headline: own command force for final verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees circumambulation receive explicit obligation equal to the first two commands.
topics.reason: The third lām al-amr directly governs the final jussive verb.

topics.headline: completed command-particle triad
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the three actions are bound by identical command architecture.
topics.reason: This is the third repeated command particle in the three coordinated jussive clauses.

topics.headline: clipped onset before heavy verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears recitational pressure where the short command particle meets the heavy final verb.
topics.reason: Variant vocalization affects onset cadence, but the local particle remains the command-governing lām.

words.gloss_range: commanded Form V circumambulation, self-involved and thorough, requiring a bāʾ-governed House complement
words.root_gloss_range: range includes circling, roaming, visiting, groups, and engulfing flood imagery; the local House complement selects ritual circumambulation while encompassment remains image-pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the bāʾ-governed House complement that supplies the circumambulation locus

words.prose: {{ar:يَطَّوَّفُوا۟}} ({{tr:yaṭṭawwafū}}) is the final jussive verb and turns the sequence into embodied spatial motion. Its Form V shape, compressed by assimilation, makes the circumambulation feel performed, thorough, and self-involved rather than caused in others. The required {{ar:بِٱلْبَيْتِ}} ({{tr:bi-l-bayti}}) complement narrows {{ar:ط و ف}} ({{tr:ṭ-w-f}}) to ritual circling around the House, while the wider field of visiting and engulfing motion gives the circling a complete, center-encompassing feel. The verb belongs to the ritual circling formula seen at 2:158, and the same-surah preparation of circumambulators in 22:26 is answered here by the command to perform the act.

topics.headline: final commanded act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final action as a commanded act assigned to the same pilgrim group.
topics.reason: The verb is a third-person masculine plural jussive governed by the final command lām.

topics.headline: House-bound circumambulation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the motion is not roaming in general but ritual circling bound to the House.
topics.reason: The verb takes a bāʾ-governed House complement, selecting circumambulation around a specific locus.

topics.headline: performed thorough circling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the pilgrims themselves performing a dense, thorough circuit rather than causing someone else to circle.
topics.reason: The local form is assimilated Form V, contrasting with causative alternatives in the family.

topics.headline: complete encircling pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels circumambulation as full movement around a center, while flood and roaming branches remain image-pressure rather than the local sense.
topics.reason: The root family supports engulfing and visiting images, but the House complement selects ritual circling.

topics.headline: sequence lands in spatial rite
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah culminate in movement around a concrete center after body and vow completion.
topics.reason: The final command expands with a required prepositional phrase identifying the circumambulation locus.

topics.headline: prepared House answered by commanded circling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this command with ritual-circling language elsewhere and with the House prepared for circumambulators in 22:26.
topics.reason: The supplied evidence links the root with House contexts and cites the same-surah preparation scene at 22:26.

topics.headline: heavy assimilated sound
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final verb's doubled pressure as fitting the repeated circling act, while the variant affects entry into the same command.
topics.reason: Assimilation and variant onset shape the recited surface without changing the local Form V command.

words.gloss_range: preposition binding the House as the genitive locus of circumambulation, not as an instrument or direct object
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) is the hinge that makes the House the locus of the final act. With the circumambulation verb, it blocks a direct-object reading and rejects instrumentality: the House is not acted on or used as a tool, but is the center around which the motion is bound. Because the preposition fuses into the definite House phrase, the final command arrives at a compact ritual formula: movement attached to a known sacred center.

topics.headline: House as circumambulation locus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the House as the encircled locus of motion, not the direct object or instrument of the act.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the House as a bāʾ-governed complement of the circumambulation verb.

topics.headline: bound spatial attachment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the motion attached closely around the House rather than placed in a vague location.
topics.reason: The preposition can mark several relations, but the local circumambulation frame selects spatial proximity or attachment.

topics.headline: gateway into House phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final command move from verb to its required sacred center through this compact prepositional opening.
topics.reason: The preposition is proclitic to the definite House noun and introduces the final phrase after the verb.

topics.headline: compact ritual formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears syntax and ritual formula coincide as the preposition binds directly to the known House.
topics.reason: The recited and written sequence joins the preposition to the definite noun phrase at the point the verb receives its locus.

words.gloss_range: the known sacred House as definite singular genitive locus of circumambulation, qualified by the following adjective
words.root_gloss_range: range includes house, dwelling, household, shelter, night-staying, building, and verse; local Hajj context selects the known sacred House while dwelling/refuge imagery remains active

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the following definite genitive adjective qualifying the House

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَيْتِ}} ({{tr:al-bayti}}) is not introduced as any house; its definite singular form presupposes the known sacred locus. The bāʾ-governed genitive makes it the center around which the final motion occurs, and its matching definiteness and case bind the following {{ar:ٱلْعَتِيقِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿatīqi}}) tightly to it. The root's dwelling and shelter field is narrowed to the Kaaba locus, but it still lets the center feel like a place of return and refuge. Same-surah links with 22:26 and 22:33 make the House a local spine: prepared for circumambulators, circled here, and named again by the same title.

topics.headline: known sacred referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a specific known House, not an indefinite building or general dwelling.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, singular, concrete, and occurs in the Hajj circumambulation frame.

topics.headline: governed locus with locked epithet
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the House as the governed circumambulation locus and the following adjective as bound to this noun.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the noun as genitive, and the following adjective agrees with it in definiteness and case.

topics.headline: shared known locus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the movement from the earlier possessive House reference to a shared definite destination for the pilgrims.
topics.reason: The local form is definite by article rather than by the earlier first-person possessive suffix.

topics.headline: dwelling image narrowed to Kaaba locus
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ritual center as a dwelling and refuge image while keeping the local referent as the known sacred House.
topics.reason: The root field supports dwelling and shelter, but the Hajj and circumambulation frame selects the sacred House.

topics.headline: House as Hajj-section spine
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the common noun become a local structural center through its pairing with circumambulation and the ancient-house title.
topics.reason: The supplied evidence ties the House to circumambulation and to the same-surah ancient-house designation.

topics.headline: final landing point
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the command sequence resolve at the House after bodily and covenantal responsibilities.
topics.reason: The final command's complement supplies the concrete locus, with same-surah echoes at 22:26 and 22:33.

topics.headline: linked closing phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the House phrase as a single closing unit carrying refuge, recurrence, and ritual-center pressure.
topics.reason: The phrase links preposition, definite noun, and adjective in the final genitive unit while the supplied evidence gives same-surah and thematic associations.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive adjective qualifying the House with ancient, freed/protected, noble, and enduring force
words.root_gloss_range: range includes oldness, antiquity, freedom, manumission, protection from subjugation, nobility, refinement, and enduring quality; local adjective binds these to the House as a stable title-like epithet

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the definite House noun qualified by the final adjective

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَتِيقِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿatīqi}}) seals the ayah by qualifying the House, not by adding an independent idea. Its definite genitive agreement locks all of its force to {{ar:ٱلْبَيْتِ}} ({{tr:al-bayti}}), and the adjective's form presents ancient/liberated status as a stable quality rather than an event of freeing. The {{ar:ع ت ق}} ({{tr:ʿ-t-q}}) field lets antiquity, freedom, protection, nobility, and refinement converge; the House is not merely old, but enduring and inviolable. Because this rare adjective recurs with the House at 22:33, the final word becomes a marked Hajj-section destination marker and the ayah's closing mechanism. Its deep-to-hard final sound gives audible weight to that closing title.

topics.headline: title-like adjective bound to House
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the adjective as part of the recognized House designation, not a loose descriptive flourish.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with the House in definiteness and genitive case and modifies it directly.

topics.headline: ancient and liberated force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the House's identity as both primordial and protected from subjugation, not merely old.
topics.reason: The adjective pattern and lexical evidence keep active and passive directions available in the House's description.

topics.headline: age as refinement

topics.reason: Lexical branches support refinement and manumission imagery, but the local adjective applies that pressure to the House's stable epithet.

topics.headline: state rather than freeing event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the House is described as possessing enduring status, not as undergoing an act of emancipation here.
topics.reason: The local form is a definite adjective, not a finite causative freeing verb.

topics.headline: rare Hajj-section keyword
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this rare adjective is reserved locally for the House and binds 22:29 to 22:33.
topics.reason: The contextual evidence marks the root as rare and paired with the House in this surah, including 22:33.

topics.headline: closing destination word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah close not merely on circling but on the House's enduring ancient/liberated identity.
topics.reason: The adjective is the final word and completes the final noun phrase after the three command sequence.

topics.headline: same phrase recurrence and final weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final adjective as a weighty marked term whose two occurrences mutually define the House title in Surah 22.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ordered construction joins q-d-y/t-f-th, w-f-y/n-dh-r, and t-w-f/b-y-t/ayn-t-q.
baseline_models.mechanism: A three-part closure moves from bodily remainder, to self-incurred verbal obligation, to repeated spatial movement around a durable dwelling: residue is removed, deficits are made whole, and the participant is re-centered.

activation_trace.role: Finishing and coming to an end supplies the temporal closure that governs the sequence.
Bodily dirt and dishevelment supply the concrete remainder to be removed.
Wholeness without deficiency makes the second act an elimination of shortfall.
A voluntarily incurred obligation supplies the verbal liability that must be completed.
Circular movement converts completion into embodied reorientation around a center.
The dwelling or refuge supplies the stable center of reintegration.
Deep temporal rootedness makes the center durable beyond the participant's temporary condition.

changed_reading.before: Three adjacent ritual commands: remove dishevelment, fulfill vows, and circumambulate.
changed_reading.after: One staged reintegration closes bodily, verbal, and spatial incompletion in that order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The q-d-y and w-f-y verbs govern t-f-th and n-dh-r before the final circuit.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah behaves like a closing ledger: bodily residue is cleared, an acquired obligation is paid without deficiency, and the completed account is enacted at the House. The earlier-binding branch of ayn-t-q keeps the settlement temporally accountable.

activation_trace.role: Payment and recovery of a due right frame the opening command as settlement.
The body's accumulated grime functions as a tangible outstanding remainder.
Full payment without loss supplies the ledger's standard of completion.
Self-obligation supplies the liability whose fulfillment closes the account.
A prior oath that has become binding extends the settlement backward to the moment of commitment.
The public circuit spatially ratifies the now-settled condition.

changed_reading.before: Grooming and vow fulfillment are separate preliminaries to circumambulation.
changed_reading.after: All three acts close different classes of outstanding claim before and at a common center.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The participant circles the b-y-t qualified by ayn-t-q after completing n-dh-r.
baseline_models.mechanism: The freedom branch of ayn-t-q creates a paradox: release is enacted not by dispersing but by shedding residue, honoring a chosen bond, and repeatedly returning around a sheltering center.

activation_trace.role: Emergence from bondage makes freedom a live quality of the House.
Repeated circling makes freedom a centered motion rather than departure without return.
Shelter gives liberated motion a stable place of belonging.
Chosen obligation prevents freedom from collapsing into absence of commitment.
Ending the liminal condition supplies the release threshold.

changed_reading.before: Al-atiq is a static epithet of the building.
changed_reading.after: The Free House organizes a form of liberation achieved through completed commitment and centered return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus sequence acquires a life-course edge: completion, bodily shedding, taking of the soul, maturity, death, and restored life make ritual closure resemble a controlled passage through mortality rather than only the end of a ceremony.

activation_trace.role: Death as an executed decree gives the focus verb a terminal edge.
Taking the soul places mortality inside the focus root's live branch range.
Emergence from childhood supplies a transition into a new completed status.
The same root explicitly supplies the taking of a life within a many-stage bodily sequence.
Living being and animation supply the restored-life side of the passage.
Loss of life supplies the opposed terminal state through which restoration passes.

structural_cues: 22:5 repeatedly uses thumma across formation, maturity, death, and revived earth, while 22:29 also opens with thumma.
22:66 later compresses life, death, and renewed life into another thumma sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated bodily transitions and the death branch of w-f-y; I infer that the rite rehearses status-death and re-entry into life; alternatively, the shared sequencing may mark only ordinary chronological completion.

changed_reading.before: The commands close a temporary pilgrimage condition.
changed_reading.after: They also rehearse a bounded death-and-reentry pattern in which an old bodily status ends and a renewed one circles the enduring center.

context_deltas.mechanism: The House is made equally available to settled attendant and outsider, then purified for circlers and other worshippers. The participant's removal of bodily residue becomes the human-side counterpart to purification of the shared center, and the circuit enacts access rather than private possession.

activation_trace.role: Removal of bodily grime supplies the participant-side purification.
Circling supplies the repeated movement by which access is enacted.
Dwelling and refuge supply the common center rather than a privately held object.
Equality between two parties makes nonexclusive access a constitutive property of the sanctuary.
Gathering around a thing supplies the stationary participant at the common center.
The open-country outsider supplies the mobile participant granted equal standing.
The repeated House reference identifies the same refuge as both assigned place and purified center.
Removal of defilement from the House mirrors removal of residue from the participant.
The named circlers identify the purified House by the movement later commanded in the focus.

structural_cues: 22:25 explicitly equates the settled attendant and the outsider at the sanctuary.
22:26 joins assignment of the House, its purification, and three bodily modes of worship.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies equality, House-purification, and named circlers; I infer reciprocal purification of participant and public center; alternatively, the bodily cleanup and building purification may remain parallel regulations without a causal relation.

changed_reading.before: A cleaned individual performs a circuit around an old sacred building.
changed_reading.after: A cleaned participant enters and reproduces an equal-access order around a correspondingly purified common refuge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah moves from bodily dirt to contaminating objects and false utterance. Tafath becomes the material threshold of a wider decontamination, while fulfilling vows is set against speech that bends away from truth.

activation_trace.role: Literal bodily grime supplies the initial, removable form of residue.
Complete fulfillment supplies the positive speech-act integrity opposed to falsity.
A self-binding utterance makes verbal truth consequential in the focus.
Filth that stains and mixes extends residue from the body into the field of objects.
Falsehood supplies the linguistic contamination opposed to fulfilling a vowed word.

structural_cues: 22:30 follows the focus immediately and pairs two avoidances: idol-filth and false speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a direct progression from t-f-th to r-j-s and false speech; I infer expansion from physical to representational and verbal residue; alternatively, tafath can remain strictly bodily while 22:30 starts a separate ethical list.

changed_reading.before: Removing tafath is grooming before worship.
changed_reading.after: Bodily grooming opens a broader purge of corrupt objects and untrue speech, so vow fulfillment becomes part of decontamination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Tafath marks the body through hair and dishevelment, while sh-ayn-r supplies both hair and a ritual sign. Removal is therefore not simple erasure: the body passes from accidental residue-sign to consciously honored sign, with heart-level self-protection governing the conversion.

activation_trace.role: Shagginess and bodily grime supply the involuntary mark that is removed.
Hair supplies the bodily medium that makes the connection materially visible.
A perceptible ritual marker converts bodily visibility into an intentionally honored sign.
Placing the self under protection locates the governing value in the heart rather than the surface alone.

structural_cues: 22:32 explicitly derives magnification of the ritual signs from the protection-consciousness of hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dishevelment, the hair/sign branch pair, and a heart source; I infer a conversion of the body's sign-state; alternatively, the hair branch may be only a form-distant lexical echo with no functional force here.

changed_reading.before: The body sheds an unwanted residue before approaching the sign-bearing sanctuary.
changed_reading.after: The body changes what it signifies: involuntary dishevelment is removed so deliberate ritual marking can be governed from the heart.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact House epithet reappears as a mahill, where place-of-arrival and untying converge. The House becomes a terminal release node at which timed benefits and incurred obligations are resolved, not merely a landmark around which movement occurs.

activation_trace.role: Discharging what is due supplies the obligation moving toward resolution.
Freedom from bondage supplies the released state at the terminus.
Untying a knot supplies the release operation associated with the endpoint.
Arrival and dwelling in a place keep the release operation spatially anchored.
The repeated refuge identifies the endpoint with the focus House.
The repeated freedom epithet makes release, rather than mere arrival, a live result.

structural_cues: 22:33 moves from benefits lasting to a named term, through thumma and mahill, to the exact phrase al-bayt al-atiq.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a terminus, the place and knot-release branches of h-l-l, and the repeated Free House; I infer that spatial arrival resolves accrued obligation; alternatively, h-l-l may contribute only the neutral place of arrival.

changed_reading.before: The House is the destination at which the completed pilgrim performs a circuit.
changed_reading.after: The House is the resolving endpoint where knots, dues, and liminal restrictions convert into release.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sacrifice sequence repeatedly turns a completed act into food transferred to people in need. Vow fulfillment therefore gains a social balance-sheet: completion is not exhausted by saying or intending the vow but can require material benefit to leave the performer.

activation_trace.role: Payment of a due right makes completion measurable by what reaches another claimant.
Fulfillment without deficiency requires the promised act to reach full effect.
Self-incurred duty supplies the obligation whose effect must be externalized.
Feeding another supplies the concrete transfer by which benefit leaves the performer.
Material need identifies a human recipient against whom completion has social consequence.
Fixed obligation activates at the body's fall and links completion to the ensuing distribution.
Repeated feeding confirms outward transfer as the sequence's material result.

structural_cues: 22:28 joins witnessed benefits, provision, eating, and feeding the distressed poor immediately before the focus.
22:36 repeats eating and feeding after the sacrificial bodies fall, while 22:37 denies that flesh or blood itself reaches God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated post-sacrifice feeding and a due-obligation branch; I infer that at least some vowed completion is socially discharged through transfer; alternatively, the feeding commands may be adjacent sacrifice rules and not specify the content of the focus vows.

changed_reading.before: Vows are completed as a private relation between the one who vowed and God.
changed_reading.after: Their completion can be tested by an outward payout that turns ritual provision into another person's sustenance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Complete fulfillment is opposed first to deficient trust and later to a promise missed at its time. The vow becomes a durable trust relation whose integrity is tested across delay, not a momentary devotional statement.

activation_trace.role: Completion without deficiency supplies the positive standard of reliability.
The voluntarily assumed duty supplies a promise whose force persists after utterance.
Deficiency in fulfillment and trust supplies the direct negative image of w-f-y.
A promise failing at its appointed time defines the temporal breach that fulfillment prevents.
A spoken promise that opens expectation supplies the relational object of trust.
A promise bounded by time or place makes delay part of fidelity rather than evidence of failure.

structural_cues: 22:47 combines non-failure of the promise with a radically expanded measure of a day.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical opposition between full and deficient performance plus a delayed but unbroken promise; I infer that human vow fulfillment participates in long-horizon reliability; alternatively, the later promise may describe only divine timing without revising the human vow.

changed_reading.before: A vow is a self-imposed act to be checked off when performed.
changed_reading.after: A vow is a trust carried intact across time, with fulfillment defined by no deficiency and no missed relational expectation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah closes by placing obedience beside absence of constriction and a protective act of holding fast. This resolves the focus paradox: freedom at the House need not mean absence of vows or orbit; it can mean release from degrading mastery through chosen, preserving attachment.

activation_trace.role: Release from bondage supplies the focus's freedom pole.
Chosen self-obligation supplies a binding that can coexist with freedom.
Orbit supplies persistent attachment to a center rather than unrestricted dispersal.
Obedience and willing compliance identify the binding order in which freedom operates.
Constriction supplies the form of binding explicitly denied to the religious order.
A hold that prevents and preserves supplies attachment as protection rather than captivity.
A binding strap one holds by gives the preserving attachment a concrete mechanism.

structural_cues: 22:78 joins the Abrahamic communal path, denial of religious constriction, established practices, and holding fast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies freedom, chosen obligation, denied constriction, and protective holding; I infer freedom-through-noncoercive attachment; alternatively, al-atiq may mean only ancient, leaving no liberation paradox to resolve.

changed_reading.before: The Free House is either an old name or a place from which restrictions end.
changed_reading.after: It centers a freedom that remains vowed and attached because the bond preserves without constricting.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it treats the rite and participant through a craft-finishing analogy. It remains anchored because the focus branches explicitly combine executed workmanship, removable residue, full completion, perimeter movement, and attained quality. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy, not as the lexical sense of tafath or al-atiq.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Q-d-y/t-f-th/w-f-y lead into a circuit around the House qualified by ayn-t-q.

activation_trace.role: Executing and perfecting workmanship supplies the finishing operation.
Surface grime and shag supply the excess removed during finishing.
Completion without deficiency supplies the quality check.
Movement around the perimeter supplies an embodied final inspection.
Fineness and attained quality supply the finished condition.

changed_reading.before: The participant performs a list of required acts.
changed_reading.after: The sequence analogically finishes a work: remove excess, meet specifications, and traverse the perimeter of the valued center.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the context surfaces concern something written and hostile striving, while their inventories also image an emancipation contract and a slave earning release. It remains valid as an activation because both branches attach directly to the focus's settlement verbs and freedom branch of al-atiq. Render it as an emancipation-ledger analogy, never as the immediate meaning of 22:4 or 22:51.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Q-d-y and w-f-y settle obligations before arrival at the House carrying the freedom branch of ayn-t-q.

activation_trace.role: Payment and recovery of a due right supply the settlement ledger.
Full performance without deficiency supplies the condition for closing the ledger.
Release from bondage supplies the ledger's transformative outcome.
A slave's written emancipation contract supplies obligation ordered toward release.
A slave's earning toward freeing the neck supplies performance that realizes contracted release.

changed_reading.before: Fulfilled vows simply end liabilities before the circuit.
changed_reading.after: They can be carried analogically as installments of an emancipation contract, with completed performance culminating at the Free House.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because it maps a local bodily circuit onto alternating time, a round vessel, flowing motion, and a held sky. It remains anchored in the focus's explicit circular and raft branches of t-w-f and its stable House center. Downstream prose should qualify it as a scale analogy, not claim that circumambulation denotes astronomy or seafaring.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: T-w-f directs repeated movement around b-y-t, with ayn-t-q supplying a temporally stable center.

activation_trace.role: Circular movement supplies the local orbit.
A bound raft that carries across water supplies a mobile platform held together in passage.
Refuge supplies the fixed center against which controlled motion is legible.
Temporal rootedness stabilizes the center across repeated cycles.
Repeated entry and exit supplies the reciprocal temporal cycle of night and day.
Roundness and rotation supply a context-scale analogue for the circuit.
A vessel moving on water links circular form to navigated passage.
Flowing motion supplies continuity rather than random displacement.
Holding and restraining supply the stabilizing force that prevents ordered motion from collapse.

changed_reading.before: Circumambulation is a local loop around a shrine.
changed_reading.after: It can analogically miniaturize an order of circulating passage: motion remains free because a durable center and a preserving hold keep it coherent.

strongest_changes: Bodily cleanup became reciprocal purification of participant and equal-access House, then widened into removal of object and speech contamination.
Vow fulfillment became both a material payout to vulnerable recipients and a trust carried without deficiency across delay.
The Free House became a release terminus and a model of nonconstrictive attachment rather than merely an ancient destination.
The hair and ritual-sign branches turned tafath removal into a change in what the body signifies.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly changed the focus through functional reversals: the one who cleans meets a House also cleaned; hair-like residue gives way to honored signs; a falling sacrificial body activates obligation and feeding; and freedom is expressed through orbit and protective holding rather than dispersal.
remaining_uncertainties: Ayn-t-q keeps freedom, antiquity, quality, and prior-binding branches live; the packet does not force one epithet reading.
The focus does not state the content of the vows, so the sacrificial and redistributive model should remain a contextual activation rather than a universal identification.
The lifecycle, workpiece, emancipation, and cosmic models are mechanism-bearing analogies, but their intentional scope cannot be established from the packet alone.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Completion moves from body to obligation to space.** `ق ض ي B004/B006` supplies completion and settling dues; `ت ف ث B001` bodily grime; `و ف ي B001` full performance without shortfall; `ن ذ ر B002` a self-binding vow; `ط و ف B001` circling. The ordered commands clear residue, complete speech-created debts, then restore motion around the house. I infer that pilgrimage closure requires bodily, legal, and spatial completion together. The verse reads as a staged reintegration rather than unrelated final tasks.
2. **The ancient house is a site of release.** `ع ت ق B003` gives antiquity, while `B001` gives release from bondage; the house was purified and made equal in 22:25-26. I infer that fulfilled vows and completed rites release pilgrims from self-assumed obligations. *Al-bayt al-ʿatīq* can therefore preserve “ancient/noble house” while activating a house through which binding reaches release.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 22:78's denial of constriction in religion made the house's release-image broader: fulfilled binding belongs within a path designed with openings rather than entanglement.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Ritual closure moves from residue to completed obligation to recentering.** Fixed `يَقْضُوا` activates `ق ض ي:B004` (completion and expiration), `تَفَث` has `ت ف ث:B001` (bodily grime and dishevelment), `يُوفُوا` activates `و ف ي:B001` (complete fullness without shortfall), and `نُذُور` activates `ن ذ ر:B002` (self-binding vow). The final motion is `ط و ف:B001` (circling) around `ب ي ت:B001` (dwelling), qualified by `ع ت ق:B001` (release from bondage) and `B003` (antiquity). The packet gives an ordered sequence; I infer that cleansing and discharged commitments free the pilgrim to return around the center. The ayah reads as procedural closure, not a loose list of rites.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `22:30-32` move from completed vow to discriminated limits, exclusive orientation, and heart-grounded emblems. This made the fixed cleanup sequence read as preparation for renewed ethical discernment, not mere post-ritual grooming.

findings.text: Bedenin arındırılması, adağın tamamlanması ve evin çevresinde dönme, ritüel kapanışı bedenden yükümlülüğe, oradan yeniden merkeze taşır.
Eski evin özgür bırakılma çağrışımı, tamamlanan yükümlülüklerin kişiyi serbest bıraktığı bir çözülme noktası oluşturur.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A prepared center draws distant bodies inward and transforms arrival into witnessed, completed worship.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, insanlar arasındaki uyuşmazlığı karara bağlama anlamıyla kesin bir buyruk verme anlamını aynı dalda açıkça destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki kesinlik, yalnızca kararın söylenmesini değil, konunun ayrılıp sonuçlandırılmasını da anlatır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir gereksinimi, ibadeti, süreyi veya başka bir işi tamamlayıp bitirme ile bir şeyin geçip gitmesi, tükenmesi ve yok olması aşamalarını açıkça destekler. Geçici çerçeve, tamamlanan eylem ile sona eren şey arasındaki katılımcı farkını koruduğu sürece uygundur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal hem bir işi bitirmeyi hem de bir şeyin sona erip tükenmesini kapsar; ölüm ve borç ödeme ancak kendi ayrı dallarında ele alınır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, sona erme bildiren biçim ile belirli iş, gereksinim, ibadet ve süre söz öbeklerini ayırır; bu kalıpların bütün ayrıntıları çıplak biçime yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi, gereksinimi, ibadeti veya süreyi son sınırına ulaştırıp tamamlamak; ya da bir şeyin süresi dolarak geçip gitmesi, tükenmesi ve ortadan kalkmasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir işi veya süreci gereken son sınıra ulaştırarak tamamlayıp bitirme.

Bir işin artık geri alınamayacak biçimde kesin olarak sonuçlanması.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi yapmak, biçimlendirmek ve kusursuzca tamamlamak ile tasarlanan eylemi kararlılıkla yürürlüğe koymayı ortak bir sonuçlandırma çekirdeğinde destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki yaratma ve yapma örnekleri, genel bir var etme anlamına genişletilmeden bu sınır içinde kullanılabilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca yapma, kusursuzca tamamlama ve eylemi yürürlüğe koyma çekirdeğidir; salt planlama, ölçme veya sözlü karar verme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, yapıp kusursuzca tamamlama çekirdeğini belirli yaratma, iş görme ve sağlam ürün söz öbeklerinden ayırır; bu örneklerin özel kapsamı çıplak biçime taşınmaz.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi yapma, biçimlendirme ve işi kusursuzca tamamlayarak sağlam duruma getirme.
Tasarlanan eylemi kararlılıkla gerçekleştirip amaçlanan sonuca kadar yürütme.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir şeyi yapıp kusursuzca tamamlamayı ve istenen eylemi sonuca kadar yürütmeyi ortaklaştırır; yaratma örneği de ortaya çıkarma ile işi bitirme aşamalarını birlikte taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak ifadesi, borçlunun borcu geri vererek ilişkiyi kapatmasını ve alacaklının hakkını istemesi ya da tahsil etmesini destekler. Geçici çerçevedeki zorunlu ödemede geçerli sayılan deve, yalnızca ayrı bir sözcük biriminin tanıklığıdır ve dal düzeyindeki kaynak ifadesinde bulunmadığı için çekirdek tanıma alınmamıştır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, borç ödeme söz öbeği ile isteme ve tahsil biçimlerini ayrı katılımcı yönleri olarak korur; tek bir kalıbın kapsamı bütün çıplak biçimlere yayılmaz.

Geçici dal çerçevesi bu durumu bir temizlik işlemi veya hac görevi değil, bedende bulunan giderilebilir kir ve bakımsızlık olarak doğru ayırır.

facets.statement: Anlamın çekirdeği, bedende veya tırnakta biriken ve giderilmesi beklenen kirlenmedir.
Kirlenme, tozlanmış ve dağınık görünüm ile kişisel bakımın bırakılmış olmasını da kapsar.
Bu dal, temizlik veya tören işlemini değil, işlemden önce bedende bulunan durumu adlandırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, anlamı bedene yapışan ve giderilmesi beklenen kir ile bakım eksikliğinden doğan dağınık, tozlu görünüm çevresinde toplar. Bu yüzden dalın özü kirin kendisi ve bakımsız haldir, onu kaldıran uygulama değildir.

Geçici çerçeve, bu dalı kirli durumdan ve törensel taş atma veya hayvan kesme işlerinden ayırarak giderme işlemleri olarak doğru tanımlar.

facets.statement: Anlamın çekirdeği, kısıtlı dönemden çıkarken bedendeki kir ve bakımsızlığı giderme işlemidir.
Tırnak kesme, bıyık alma, saç kesme veya kısaltma ve benzeri beden bakımı işleri örneklenir.
Koltuk altı ve kasık temizliği, genel temizlik ve koku sürme de aynı giderme alanına dahil edilir.
Kapsam, hac kısıtları sona ererken yapılan bakım işlerine bağlıdır ve cinsel ilişkiyi dışarıda bırakır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak kanıt, dalı kısıtlı hac döneminden çıkışta yapılan beden bakım ve temizlik işleri olarak toplar. Sayılan işler kirin giderilmesine ve normal bakım yasaklarının kalkmasına bağlıdır; bu yüzden anlam, yalnızca kirli hal değil o halin kaldırılmasıdır.

facets.statement: Anlamın çekirdeği, hac görevleri içinde yer alan törensel işlerin bu ad altında toplanmasıdır.
Taş atma, hayvan kesme ve kurbanlık büyükbaş veya küçükbaş hayvanları kesme örnek olarak verilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin hiçbir eksiği kalmadan tamamına ve gereken düzeye erişmesi ya da bu tamlığın sağlanmasıdır. Söz ve şartların yerine getirilmesi, ölçü ve tartının tam verilmesi, hak ile ücretin eksiksiz ödenmesi ve bir şeyin bütününün alınması bu çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şey bütün gerekleri karşılanarak tam ve eksiksiz hale gelir ya da bu hale getirilir.
Söz, antlaşma veya şart bağlamında üstlenilen yükümlülük eksiksiz yerine getirilir ve bozulmaz.
Ölçü, tartı, hak veya ücret bağlamında verilmesi gereken miktar hiçbir eksiltme yapılmadan verilir.
Bir şey ya da belirli bir sayı, hiçbir parçası geride bırakılmadan bütünüyle alınır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak anlatımı eksiksiz tamamlanma düşüncesini; söz ve şartların yerine getirilmesinde, ölçü ve ödemede tamlığın sağlanmasında ve bir şeyin bütününün alınmasında sürdürür.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifade yüksek bir yere çıkıp onun üstüne erişmeyi ve oradan aşağıya ya da çevreye bakmayı açıkça birleştirir. Kuşun üzerine çıktığı gözetleme yeri de aynı uzamsal yapının adlaşmış örneğidir; bu nedenle dal kimliği kaynak ifadeyle uyumludur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yüksek yere çıkıp bakma kalıbı, kuşun konduğu yüksek yer adı ve bunu sık yapan niteliği ayrı sözlüksel gerçekleşmeler olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükseltinin tepesine ya da üst bölümüne çıkıp oradan aşağıya veya çevreye bakar duruma gelmektir. Kuşun gözetlemek için üzerine çıktığı yüksek yer ve yüksek çıkıntılara sık çıkan varlık bu uzamsal çekirdeğe bağlı ad ve nitelik kullanımlarıdır.

facets.statement: Bir varlık yüksek bir yerin üstüne erişir ve oradan aşağıya ya da çevreye bakar.
Bir kuşun çevreyi gözetlemek için üzerine çıktığı yüksek nokta bu eyleme göre adlandırılır.
Yüksek çıkıntıların üstüne sık çıkan varlık, bu davranışı alışkanlık edinmiş olarak nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar yüksek bir yerin tepesine ulaşmayı oradan çevreye bakma durumuyla birleştirir ve kuşun gözetleme amacıyla çıktığı yüksek yeri bu eylemin adlaşmış uzantısı olarak verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadenin baskın bölümü birinin gelmesi, belirlenen zamanda bir başkasının yanına ulaşması ve grubun katılımını tamamlamasıdır. Aynı ifade, mali kayıt hesabındaki ayrı bir kullanımı hakkın eksiksiz ödenmesi düşüncesine bağladığı için dal ancak bu türemiş kullanım geliş çekirdeğinden ayrı tutulduğunda doğru temsil edilir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Belirlenen zamanda gelme ve topluca hazır bulunma çekirdektir; mali kayıt kullanımı eksiksiz ödeme düşüncesine bağlı ayrı bir kaynak çeşididir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın gelme, belirlenen zamanda birine ulaşma ve grubun tam katılımı ayrı gerçekleşmelerdir; mali kayıt kullanımı bunlarla kaynaştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimsenin gelmesi, özellikle belirlenmiş zamanda bir başkasının yanına ulaşması; bir topluluğun da tüm üyelerinin gelerek hazır bulunmasıdır. Ayrıca mali kayıt hesabında, hakkın eksiksiz ödenmesi düşüncesinden türemiş ayrı bir kullanım bulunur.

facets.statement: Bir kişi bir yere ya da başka bir kişinin yanına gelir ve ulaşır.
Bir kişi belirlenmiş zamanda diğer kişinin yanına gelerek sözleşilen buluşmayı gerçekleştirir.
Bir topluluğun üyeleri gelerek katılımı tamamlar ve hep birlikte hazır bulunur.
Mali kayıt hesabındaki kullanım, bir hakkın eksiksiz biçimde ödenmiş olması düşüncesinden türetilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımı yalın gelmeyi, belirlenen zamanda birinin yanına ulaşmayı ve bir grubun bütün üyeleriyle hazır bulunmasını bir araya getirir; ayrıca mali kayıttaki ayrı kullanımı hakkın eksiksiz ödenmesine bağlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiye ya da topluluğa korkulacak bir durumu bildirip onları sakınmaya uyandırma anlamıdır. Uyaran kişi, uyarı olayı, karşılıklı uyarma ve tehlikeyi öğrenip korunmaya geçme kullanımları bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da topluluğa korkulacak bir durumu haber vererek onları sakınmaya yöneltir.
Aynı çekirdek, uyaran kişi veya uyarı olayının kendisi için adlaşmış kullanımlara taşır.
Topluluk içinde birbirini tehlikeye karşı uyarma, çekirdeğin karşılıklı eylem biçimidir.
Düşmandan haberdar olup hazırlık ve korunmaya geçme, bilginin sakınma sonucunu gösterir.
Ani tehlike habercisi ve ordunun öncü gözcüsü gibi sözler, uyarı çekirdeğine bağlı örneklerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, korkulacak bir durumu haber vererek karşı tarafı sakınmaya uyandırma eylemidir. Aynı malzeme uyaran kişi, uyarının kendisi, karşılıklı uyarma ve tehlikeyi öğrenince korunmaya geçme kullanımlarını da bu çekirdeğe bağlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Branch phrase correctly treats the sense as a person placing a non-obligatory matter on themself as a binding duty. The supplied claim repeatedly frames the act as making something required on oneself, including a vow directed to God or a conditional promise.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: The branch is self-imposed obligation, not warning communication and not injury compensation except by the broad idea of becoming due.

lexicalization_scope.note: The mechanical scope keeps the bare noun, the verb, and constructions such as making it for God or on oneself together while preventing those constructions from becoming a general promise sense.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin kendisine daha önce zorunlu olmayan bir şeyi gerekli ve bağlayıcı bir yükümlülük yapmasıdır. Bu yükümlülük Tanrı'ya yönelik bir adak, kişinin kendi üzerine aldığı söz veya bir şarta bağlanan vaat olarak gerçekleşebilir.

facets.statement: Kişi kendi üzerine önceden zorunlu olmayan bir işi bağlayıcı yükümlülük haline getirir.
Yükümlülük Tanrı'ya yöneltilen bir adak ya da kişinin kendi üzerine aldığı bağlayıcı söz olabilir.
Bazı kullanımlarda yükümlülük, belirli bir olay gerçekleşirse yerine getirilecek şartlı söz biçimindedir.
Adak yoluyla ibadethane hizmetine ayrılan çocuk adlandırması, yükümlülüğün sonucuna bağlı özel kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, kişinin kendi üzerine aslında zorunlu olmayan bir şeyi gerekli kılmasıdır. Malzeme bunu adak nesnesi, eylem, Tanrı'ya yöneltilmiş yükümlülük, kişinin kendi üzerine bağlayıcı söz alması ve şartlı vaat biçimleriyle açıklar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Branch phrase frames the sense as a wound that has a required compensatory amount, and the supplied claim supports that by restricting the use to injury payments, named wound cases, and a single wound with an owed amount. This is not the devotional vow branch, even though both can involve something becoming due.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: The branch is restricted to compensation owed for wounds, not a general vow, warning, or ordinary injury description.

lexicalization_scope.note: The mechanical scope keeps the injury-payment lexical unit and the named wound collocation within a restricted legal sense, without generalizing it to every wound or every due payment.

concept_map.definition: Yaralamalar için ödenmesi gereken karşılık ya da bedel anlamıdır. Özellikle belirli yara türleri ve tek bir yaranın ölçülmüş karşılığı gibi hukuki bağlamlarda kullanılır.

facets.statement: Bir yaralama için ödenmesi gereken karşılık veya bedel çekirdeğini taşır.
Kullanım özellikle küçük-büyük yaralarda ve tek bir yaranın karşılığı bulunduğunda geçer.
Aynı karşılık için bazı hukuk çevrelerinde başka bir teknik ad bulunduğu belirtilir.
Kemiği açığa çıkaran yara için belirli bir pay gibi örnekler, bedelin yara türüne bağlandığını gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek, yaralamalar için ödenmesi gereken karşılık veya bedeldir. Malzeme bu kullanımı genel adak ya da uyarı alanından ayırır; küçük ve büyük yaralar, tek yaraya düşen bedel, kemiği açığa çıkaran yara örneği ve farklı teknik adlandırma notu bu sınırı destekler.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök çok dallı bir yapı gösterir: tehlikeyi bildirerek sakındırma, kişinin kendine adak yükümlülüğü koyması ve yaralama için ödenmesi gereken karşılık ayrı çekirdeklerdir. Dallar, uyarı iletişimi, gönüllü bağlanma ve hukuki bedel eksenlerinde ayrılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin çevresinde dolaşmayı temel anlam olarak verir; kutsal bir yapının çevresinde dönme, bu hareketin tekrarlanması ve hizmetçilerin sıkça dolaşması bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu yapıyı doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel hareket ile belirli nesneler çevresindeki kalıplaşmış kullanımlar ve sık dolaşan kişilere verilen ad birbirine karıştırılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal hem çevrede dolaşma eylemini hem de belirli tümleçlerle kurulan kullanımları içerir; tanım bu iki düzeyi ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin çevresinde dolaşmak veya dönmek; bu hareketin tekrarlı yapılması ve işi gereği insanların arasında sıkça dolaşan kişiler bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Hareket eden kişi, bir nesneyi ya da yeri merkez alarak onun çevresinde dolaşır.
Belirli bir yapının çevresinde dönme, nesnesi belirtilmiş özel bir gerçekleşmedir.
Hareketin tekrar edilmesi veya çok yapılması, temel çevrede dolaşma eyleminin sıklık uzantısıdır.
İnsanların arasında işleri gereği sürekli dolaşan hizmetçiler, bu sık hareket özellikleriyle adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımı, bir nesnenin veya yapının çevresinde dolaşma çekirdeğinde birleşir; tekrarlı dolaşma ile hizmetçilerin sık hareketi bu çekirdekten gelişen kullanımlardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, baskın su veya yağmurun her yanı kaplamasını çekirdek alır; karanlık benzetmesi ile insanı kuşatan her türlü olay bu kaplayıcılığın uzantılarıdır. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu ortak sınırı doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca çok miktarda suyu değil, çevreyi ya da kişiyi bütünüyle kaplayan baskın olayı gerektirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal yalın biçimde tanıklanmıştır; tanım herhangi bir özel söz öbeğine bağlı olmayan kaplayıcı olay anlamını verir.

facets.statement: Baskın su ya da yağmur geniş bir alanı kaplar ve içindekileri kuşatır.
Karanlık, her yanı kaplayan suya benzetilerek aynı kuşatıcı görüntüyle anlatılır.
İnsanı her yönden saran herhangi bir olay, suyla sınırlı olmayan genel bir uzantıdır.
